name: Act II · the roots — the opening
rule: every beat a datum; the season line reads seasons.json; the hold names the gesture. The roots — the humans — come next, with source: and consent:.

beats.line: the point where the thread pierces the ground — at rest, sixty to the minute
from below, grey and white: dew, after the fire — before any season has a colour
one becomes two — Líf, and Lífþrasir: the two who survived inside the tree
they stay under the ground, and hold it from beneath
— and in the corner of the frame, recognised: the two rings, the C, the cube that was taken out. The mark.

hold.door: The tree is held from beneath.
hold.hint: the humans come next · any key, or touch
hold.after: — a hand. The roots grow from here.

source: Vafþrúðnismál 45 — Líf and Lífþrasir, who hide in Hoddmímis holt and live on the morning dew; the realm's own reading (assets/myth.md)
